detail.title: Arrival task
lines: In your book: Glue in today’s strip; date it. Answer questions 1 to 4.

lines: In your book: Number 1 to 3. Write one precise answer for each.

detail.title: I do · a worked method
lines: In your book: Watch how relevant evidence supports a point. No writing yet.

detail.title: We do · match the evidence
lines: In your book: Match evidence to an influence; explain one link.

detail.title: Check the idea
lines: In your book: Write the letter of your answer. Explain one clue.

detail.title: Short individual book check
lines: In your book: Answer 1 to 5 briefly; use point, evidence and explanation for 6.

detail.title: Review and improve
lines: In your book: Read back one answer (?); improve it and mark //.

detail.title: Exit ticket
lines: In your book: Explain one belief-to-choice link using relevant evidence.
